title: 반딧불 여름 캠핑장
description: 반딧불이 춤추는 여름밤 숲속 캠핑장에서 다섯 가지 차이를 찾아보세요.
scene: A cozy whimsical summer campsite in a forest clearing at night, with a large canvas tent, a glowing campfire ring, a red enamel kettle, a picnic basket, a striped blanket, a wooden acoustic guitar without lettering, a lantern string between two trees, three marshmallows on roasting sticks, a small friendly raccoon, wildflowers, fireflies, and a crescent moon above distant pine-covered hills
style: premium whimsical storybook illustration, deep summer greens and indigo blue balanced with warm amber firelight, coral red and golden accents, crisp readable props, richly detailed but uncluttered
